name: Otoko no Ko no Hoshi
source:
This planet... is a pleasureland. 

It's the space renaissance age. 

We are traveling to new planets and discovering virginal, inhabitable world. 

One world is home to a tiny colony of three. 
They are brothers. They are crossdressers. 
They are the founders of a new paradise: Otokonokonia.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE178276.html]DLsite english[/url]]
